en.title: Texas attorney general-elect vows not to defend Ten Commandments law
en.dek: Incoming Texas attorney general vows not to defend Ten Commandments classroom law
facts: The incoming Texas attorney general vowed not to defend the Ten Commandments classroom law according to Fox News.
New California law could keep teens in booster seats until age 16 unless they pass a test according to Fox News.
body: Fox News reported that the incoming Texas attorney general vowed not to defend the Ten Commandments classroom law.
Another report from Fox News stated that a new California law could keep teens in booster seats until age 16 unless they pass a test.
en.context: Sources mention various political developments, including a Democratic socialist nominee facing scrutiny and a budget deficit warning, but no single context connects these to the Texas law refusal.
en.imageCaption: DSA-backed House freshmen face scrutiny over defund police, ICE comments

pt.title: O novo procurador-geral do Texas promete não defender a lei dos Mandamentos na sala de aula
pt.dek: Procurador-geral eleito do Texas promete não defender a lei dos Mandamentos na sala de aula
facts: O novo procurador-geral do Texas prometeu não defender a lei dos Mandamentos na sala de aula segundo a Fox News
Uma nova lei da Califórnia poderia manter adolescentes em assentos de elevação até aos 16 anos, a menos que passem um teste, segundo a Fox News
body: A Fox News noticiou que o futuro procurador-geral do Texas prometeu não defender a lei que obriga à colocação dos Dez Mandamentos nas salas de aula.
Outra notícia da Fox News indicava que uma nova lei da Califórnia poderá obrigar os adolescentes a usar assentos elevatórios até aos 16 anos, a menos que passem num teste.
pt.context: Fontes mencionam vários desenvolvimentos políticos, incluindo um candidato socialista democrata a enfrentar escrutínio e um aviso de défice orçamental, mas nenhum contexto único liga estes ao recusa da lei do Texas
pt.imageCaption: Recém-eleitos da DSA enfrentam escrutínio sobre comentários para desfinanciar a polícia e ICE

zh.title: 德州总检察长当选人誓言不辩护《十诫》课堂法律
zh.dek: 当选德州总检察长誓言不辩护《课堂十诫》法律
facts: 根据福克斯新闻报道，当选德州总检察长誓言不辩护《课堂十诫》法律
根据福克斯新闻报道，新加州法律可能要求16岁以下青少年使用安全座椅，除非他们通过测试
body: 据福克斯新闻报道，德克萨斯州候任总检察长誓言，将不会为该州要求在教室内张贴“十诫”的法律进行辩护。
福克斯新闻的另一篇报道称，加利福尼亚州一项新法规定，青少年除非通过相关测试，否则可能必须使用增高座椅直至16岁。
zh.context: 来源提及各种政治发展，包括一位民主社会主义候选人面临审查以及预算赤字警告，但与德州法律的拒绝没有单一的关联
zh.imageCaption: 支持DSA的新当选众议员因关于撤警和ICE评论的言论而受到审查

ko.title: 텍사스 법무장관 당선자, 십계명 법 방어 않겠다고 맹세
ko.dek: 차기 텍사스 법무장관, 십계명 교실 법 방어 거부 선언
facts: 폭스뉴스로 보도된 바에 따르면 차기 텍사스 법무장관은 십계명 교실 법을 방어하지 않겠다고 맹세했다
폭스뉴스에 따르면 새로운 캘리포니아 법은 청소년이 시험에 합격하지 않는 한 16세까지 부스터 시트에 탑승하도록 할 수 있다
body: 폭스뉴스는 텍사스주 법무장관 당선자가 교실 내 십계명 게시를 의무화한 법을 변호하지 않겠다고 공언했다고 보도했다.
폭스뉴스의 또 다른 보도에 따르면, 캘리포니아주에서 새로 제정된 법에 따라 청소년들은 시험을 통과하지 못할 경우 16세까지 카시트를 의무적으로 사용해야 할 수도 있다.
ko.context: 소식통들은 민주사회주의 후보에 대한 조명과 예산 적자 경고를 포함한 다양한 정치적 발전을 언급했으나, 이 중 어느 것도 텍사스 법에 대한 거부와 직접적으로 연결되지는 않았다
ko.imageCaption: DSA 지지 하원의원 신입 의원들, 경찰 기금 삭감 및 ICE 발언 관련 조명에 직면

es.title: El próximo fiscal general de Texas promete no defender la ley de los Diez Mandamientos
es.dek: El entrante fiscal general de Texas promete no defender la ley de los Diez Mandamientos en las aulas
facts: El próximo fiscal general de Texas prometió no defender la ley de los Diez Mandamientos en las aulas según Fox News
Una nueva ley de California podría mantener a los adolescentes en sillas elevadoras hasta los 16 años a menos que aprueben una prueba según Fox News
body: Fox News informó que el próximo fiscal general de Texas prometió no defender la ley de las Diez Mandamientos en las aulas.
Otro informe de Fox News señaló que una nueva ley de California podría exigir que los adolescentes usen sillas elevadoras hasta los 16 años, a menos que aprueben una prueba.
es.imageCaption: Los recién llegados a la Cámara respaldados por DSA son objeto de escrutinio por la propuesta de desfinanciar a la policía y comentarios sobre ICE

it.title: Il futuro procuratore generale del Texas giura di non difendere la legge dei Dieci Comandamenti
it.dek: Il prossimo procuratore generale del Texas si impegna a non sostenere la legge sui Dieci Comandamenti nelle aule scolastiche
facts: Il futuro procuratore generale del Texas ha giurato di non difendere la legge dei Dieci Comandamenti nelle aule scolastiche secondo Fox News
Una nuova legge californiana potrebbe mantenere gli adolescenti in seggiolini rinforzati fino ai 16 anni a meno che non superino un test secondo Fox News
body: Fox News ha riportato che il futuro procuratore generale del Texas ha giurato di non difendere la legge sulle Dieci Regole in classe.
Un altro resoconto di Fox News ha indicato che una nuova legge californiana potrebbe obbligare gli adolescenti a usare seggiolini rinforzati fino ai 16 anni, a meno che non superino un esame.
it.imageCaption: I neomembri della Camera sostenuti dal DSA sono sotto esame per i commenti sulla riduzione dei fondi alla polizia e all'ICE

ja.title: テキサス州司法長官選出候補者は十戒法を擁護しないと誓う
ja.dek: 新任テキサス州司法長官は教室における十戒法を擁護しないと誓う
facts: フォックス・ニュースによると、新任テキサス州司法長官は十戒法を擁護しないと誓った
フォックス・ニュースによると、新しいカリフォルニア州法では、若者がテストに合格しない限り16歳までブースターシートの着用が義務付けられる可能性がある
body: フォックス・ニュースが報じたところによると、テキサス州司法長官選出候補者は、十戒の教室法を擁護しないと誓った。
フォックス・ニュースによる別の報道では、新しいカリフォルニア州の法律により、若者はテストに合格しない限り16歳までブースターシートを使用し続ける可能性があると報じられた。
ja.context: 様々な政治的動向、例えば民主社会主義の候補者が精査されていることや財政赤字の警告などが報じられているが、これらがテキサス州の法律拒否と結びつく単一の文脈はない
ja.imageCaption: DSAを支持する下院の新人議員たちが、警察やICEへの資金提供停止に関する発言で精査を受けている

de.title: translated headline
body: Fox News berichtete, dass der zukünftige Generalstaatsanwalt von Texas versprach, das Gesetz über das Zehn-Gebote-Klassenzimmer nicht zu verteidigen.
Ein weiterer Bericht von Fox News besagte, dass ein neues kalifornisches Gesetz Jugendliche bis zum Alter von 16 Jahren in Aufprallschutzsitzeln halten könnte, es sei denn, sie bestehen einen Test.
de.imageCaption: translated image caption, or NOTHING Let's translate each part: Title: "Texas attorney general-elect vows not to defend Ten Commandments law" - attorney general-elect = designierter Generalstaatsanwalt (or gewählter Generalstaatsanwalt). "Attorney general-elect" is the person who has been elected but not yet taken office. In German: "designierter Generalstaatsanwalt" or "gewählter Generalstaatsanwalt". "Designierter" is common in German news. - vows not to defend = kündigt an, nicht zu verteidigen / will nicht verteidigen - Ten Commandments law = Gesetz über die Zehn Gebote / Zehn-Gebote-Gesetz. In context of classroom law: "Gesetz zur Anbringung der Zehn Gebote in Klassenzimmern" or similar. The dek says "Ten Commandments classroom law". So title could be: "Designierter Generalstaatsanwalt von Texas will Gesetz über Zehn Gebote in Klassenzimmern nicht verteidigen" Dek: "Incoming Texas attorney general vows not to defend Ten Commandments classroom law" - Incoming = designierter / kommender / neuer. "Designierter" is good. - Texas attorney general = Generalstaatsanwalt von Texas - vows not to defend = will nicht verteidigen / kündigt an, nicht zu verteidigen - Ten Commandments classroom law = Gesetz über die Zehn Gebote in Klassenzimmern / Zehn-Gebote-Klassenzimmergesetz. Maybe "Gesetz zur Anbringung der Zehn Gebote in Klassenzimmern". But keep it concise. "Gesetz über die Zehn Gebote in Klassenzimmern" or "Klassenzimmer-Gesetz über die Zehn Gebote". Actually "Ten Commandments classroom law" is a law requiring Ten Commandments in classrooms. In German: "Gesetz über die Zehn Gebote in Klassenzimmern" or "Zehn-Gebote-Gesetz für Klassenzimmer". fr.title: Le futur procureur général du Texas s'engage à ne pas défendre la loi des Dix Commandements
fr.dek: Le prochain procureur général du Texas promet de ne pas défendre la loi sur les Dix Commandements en classe
facts: Le futur procureur général du Texas a promis de ne pas défendre la loi des Dix Commandements en classe selon Fox News
Une nouvelle loi californienne pourrait maintenir les adolescents en siège d'appoint jusqu'à 16 ans s'ils ne réussissent pas un test selon Fox News
body: Fox News a rapporté que le futur procureur général du Texas s'est engagé à ne pas défendre la loi sur les Dix Commandements en classe.
Un autre report de Fox News a indiqué qu'une nouvelle loi californienne pourrait obliger les adolescents à rester en siège d'appoint jusqu'à l'âge de 16 ans, sauf s'ils réussissent un test.
fr.imageCaption: Les nouveaux membres de la Chambre soutenus par le DSA font l'objet d'un examen concernant le démantèlement des fonds de la police et les commentaires sur l'ICE

problemsFixed: The draft includes multiple claims not supported by the sources (e.g., 'Socialist newcomers' is a Fox News headline framing, not a fact; the specific details about Avila Chevalier and Mamdani are mixed with unrelated content from the Fox News source, and the draft attributes these to Fox News without specific textual support for each claim).
The draft uses evaluative framing in the 'context' section ('reflects ongoing legal and political debates').

The draft contains unsupported claims about Avila Chevalier's preparation to enter Congress or the specific nature of the scrutiny over her tweets, beyond the mention of her being a 'Democratic socialist nominee' in a headline context.
